title: Predictive Churn & Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
tagline: Keep and grow the revenue you already have: an NRR / GRR bridge from MRR snapshots, explainable health and renewal-risk scores, and usage drop-off and expansion alerts against each account's own baseline.
why: For a SaaS company past early growth, net revenue retention decides the valuation more than new logos do. Churn rarely surprises the data: usage drops, the champion leaves, seats go unused, and renewal gets close. The work is to see it early, explain it in one line a CSM can act on, and catch the expansion signals on the same screen.
covers: NRR / GRR bridge: new, reactivation, expansion, contraction, churn per account; formulas use the starting cohort only; GRR capped at 100%
Health score: signals normalized between a bad and a good value (either direction), weights, trend vs last period, green / yellow / red bands, missing signals listed
Renewal risk: low health + urgency from days to renewal + named risk events (champion left, P1 ticket), with the play to run and the biggest drag
Usage alerts: drop-off when every recent week is below baseline by a threshold; expansion on sustained growth or seat utilization; shelfware under 50% seats
gaps: Risk weights are set by hand, not fit on historical churn (no logistic regression or survival model yet)
No CRM / CS platform connection: snapshots and signals are synthetic JSON
No seasonality adjustment in the usage baseline

ops.label: NRR bridge
ops.help: Compare start-of-year and end-of-year MRR per account to get the NRR and GRR bridge.

ops.label: Health + renewal risk
ops.help: Score account health from five signals, then rank renewal risk with days to renewal and risk events.

ops.label: Usage alerts
ops.help: Compare the last 3 weeks with each account's own baseline. Flag drop-off, expansion and shelfware.
